# HdrHistogram_c

This directory vendors the core of [HdrHistogram_c 0.12.1](https://github.com/HdrHistogram/HdrHistogram_c/commit/30e9ce6ef5dcdc60f9270e1ca03c0966eaaf71d0),
release commit `30e9ce6ef5dcdc60f9270e1ca03c0966eaaf71d0`.

`hdr_histogram.c` and `hdr_histogram.h` are generated by the upstream
`script/amalgamate.py` with `--malloc-include hdr_redis_malloc.h`. The core includes
recording, percentile queries, and iterators. It uses libc and libm (plus libatomic on platforms that require it);
the log codec, packed histogram, interval recorder, and phaser are not included.

Redis maintains the `Makefile` and `hdr_redis_malloc.h` allocator shim. There are
no hand-maintained changes to the generated library files. See the
[dependency upgrade instructions](../README.md#hdr_histogram) to regenerate them.

The upstream license texts are in [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) and
[COPYING.txt](COPYING.txt).
